title: Preserve exact growing-carrier decoding and dirty-host capture components
body:
This adds two exact local constructions for centre-information work: a decoder with three prepared carriers and growing read frames, and a scalar program that captures eight mixed forms in existing dirty helpers. They provide concrete interfaces and replay fixtures for later construction work. They are separate results; no composition between them, strict total-cost improvement, complete supplier, or kappa improvement is claimed.

For the prepared decoder, start with the [proof and physical endpoint](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/prepared-growing-carrier/historical/work/autonomous-kappa-run/growing-cycle-independent/PROOF.md), [fresh receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/prepared-growing-carrier/replayed-receipt.json), and [independent agent review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/prepared-growing-carrier/review/REVIEW.txt). For the dirty-helper capture, start with the [operation and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/local-eight-form-capture/README.md), [fresh receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/local-eight-form-capture/replayed-receipt.json), and [independent agent review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/local-eight-form-capture/review/REVIEW.md). Both packages retain their frozen source files and exact input hashes in the [decoder manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/prepared-growing-carrier/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json) and [capture manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/local-eight-form-capture/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json).

- **Prepared carriers with growing read frames.** One finite complex word acts on 11 streams of 64 values. Three carriers start in the prescribed line frames at ports `e_0,e_2,e_4`; eight targets start in the identity frame, with arbitrary values. Its scalar endpoint is `X_i -> X_i` and `Y_t -> Y_t + sum_i bit_i(t) X_i`, for `0 <= t < 8`. A carrier can grow after an earlier target is served while all pending targets remain compatible. Thus a single final read frame need not describe all earlier reads. This gives an explicit counterexample to extending the retained fixed-read-frame argument to arbitrary growing frames. It does not refute that argument under its stated fixed-frame premise or prove a bound for all decoders.
- **Eight mixed forms in dirty helpers.** One forward scalar program acts on 800 arbitrary input fields: 120 X fields, 120 Y fields, and 560 helpers. It preserves X, sends `Y -> Y+SX`, and sends the eight helpers indexed 758 through 751 to `h_i + C_i(59X/4+Y)`. It preserves every other helper. On the 112 code ports, `S = I-C^T C/4` and `C C^T = 56I`; the other eight ports have zero S rows and zero C columns. This gives a concrete fixture for testing a proposed composition against all old helper values. The eight selected helpers are future Y data owners, so their old contents are live data. They are not restored by this forward program.

The decoder has 39 base events: 12 ADD scans and 27 positive-rank children, with profile `15 H_1 + 2 H_2 + 5 H_3 + 4 H_4 + H_5` and rank mass 55. Here `H_r` denotes a child of rank r. Every stream makes strict nested frame ascents with total rank growth five. There are 23 distinct recipes, 54 applied monomial records around the children, and no COPY. The [saved exit extension](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/prepared-growing-carrier/historical/work/p518-next/complex/paired-five/GROWING-CYCLE-LEGACY-EXITS-WORD.json) adds eight exact monomial adapters with zero positive child rank, giving target operator `F C_q^-1` instead of the canonical hyperplane operator. These are counts of local calls and records, not a complete primitive invoice. Source preparation, scalar and monomial primitives, routing, storage, precision, owner control, and recursive hosting remain unpriced.

The decoder preserves carrier values in scalar coordinates, not their physical arrays. Carrier i finishes as `T_FULL T_(e_(2*i))^-1 h_i`; target t finishes as `T_(q(t)^perp) (h_(3+t) + sum_i bit_i(t) T_(e_(2*i))^-1 h_i)`, where `q(t) = sum_i e_(2*i+bit_i(t))`. Exact global phases and the literal inverse are checked. The exit extension changes only the target operators. An inverse check does not make the forward carriers physically restored.

The capture program uses 19,449 base scalar operations, 11,326 dirt-correction operations, and two 448-term loads: **31,671 scalar operations** in total. Its base map is `Y -> Y+SX+Dh`. With P inserting the eight C rows into the selected helpers, the program forms `h1=h+PY`, corrects `Y1=Y-Dh1`, runs the base word, and adds `(59/4)PX` to those helpers. Fresh review proves that the eight selected columns of D are zero, so `DP=0`. The generic stale-helper warning in the unchanged historical review therefore does not apply to this fixed selection; the implemented order is valid, but that warning does not prove it necessary. The [boundary count and D-column check](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/local-eight-form-capture/review/BOUNDARY-COUNT-CONTROL.json) records this correction.

The capture's zero-frame preload and dirt correction, and its full-frame postload, satisfy the saved local label contracts. They do not supply a paid native or phase realization of those boundary operations. No backward program, physical endpoint decoder, routed controller, restoration of the eight hosts, or complete recursive invoice is included. The retained endpoint check finds nonzero chart translations and rejects a proposed two-tap tensor inverse shortcut. That shortcut is not used by the capture program.

From the repository root, use Python 3.10 or later, the standard library, and two new output directories:

```sh
python3 -B research/prepared-growing-carrier/verify.py --build /tmp/prepared-growing-carrier-replay
python3 -B research/local-eight-form-capture/verify.py --build /tmp/local-eight-form-capture-replay
```

Expected final lines, respectively:

```text
PASS_PREPARED_GROWING_CARRIER 704 55 8
PASS_LOCAL_EIGHT_FORM_CAPTURE 800 8 11326
```

The fresh checks establish the following local claims:

- The decoder reconstructs both saved words and receipts. A separate Gaussian-integer interpreter checks all 1,472 recipe basis columns, all 704 physical input columns, and all 704 inverse round trips, including global phase, common labels at each ADD, and pending-target compatibility. It shares the canonical frame definitions with the producer but imports neither the builder nor its lowering procedure. Additional [review controls](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/prepared-growing-carrier/review/CONTROLS.json) check 512 exit columns and 512 inverse exit columns, reject exit and child phase mutations and an ADD sign mutation, and test source pins and output guards. The reported 1,066 control assertions include individual basis columns; they are not 1,066 independent mutation cases.
- The capture replay reproduces four complete historical receipts: the sparse-row map, a separate 800-column base replay with symbolic boundary composition, a separate 800-column complete-capture replay, and the endpoint/covariance limits. An extra review check recounts both load supports and the base operations, checks the boundary frames, and tests all eight selected D columns. It uses the retained column interpreter; it is not a third independent implementation of that interpreter. Exact linearity extends the checked columns to arbitrary input values.

Both full replays also passed with isolated parents and `PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1` in the environment; their child processes ignore Python environment options. The wrappers check source hashes, require new output paths, and reject optimized parent execution. The original historical scripts remain unchanged; portable copies replace absolute paths with explicit input/output arguments and add assertion guards. No floating-point approximation is used to establish these local maps.

The base is [cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703). The existing [shared-carrier decoder](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703/research/shared-carrier-decoder/README.md) has a different P111 interface, 452 dirty helpers, and a nonzero COPY endpoint. The existing [native centre capture](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703/research/native-centre-capture/README.md) has 640 inputs and 16 centre records with different native endpoints. These local packages do not add costs or transfer theorems across those models. No priority claim for a general capture principle is made.

The consumed sources and their credit are:

- The decoder's exact Clifford definitions came through the historical [PR #518](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/518) copy. Their bytes match [this source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e07a8a3f9f79c22113398a0c5dbbc7601f489b3e/research/direct-delivery504-global/vendor/clifford/clifford_exact.py) at `e07a8a3f9f79c22113398a0c5dbbc7601f489b3e`, from @icekylinx's [PR #531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/531). The [retained notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/prepared-growing-carrier/public-source/NOTICE.md) and [source ledger](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/prepared-growing-carrier/public-source/SOURCES.json) preserve the predecessor credit.
- The capture uses a retimed R560 word from the local lineage of [PR #495](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/495), whose [proof is pinned at 355d9f7ff293e291676ff4a32eed434419692576](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/355d9f7ff293e291676ff4a32eed434419692576/research/e8-combined/PROOF.txt). Its two generated inputs have their own exact SHA256 pins; they are not claimed byte-identical to a published generated file. The [retained notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/local-eight-form-capture/historical/work/combined-pr/publication/research/e8-combined/NOTICE) credits Ali Romman with OpenAI Codex assistance for the changed R560 word and composition. It credits @DreamingOfClouds for the [PR #449](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/449) kernel scripts, @chafreaky for the [PR #458](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/458) paid adapters and distinct-host construction, and @icekylinx for the [PR #433](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/433) split centres. The [source ledger](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bedaae147ede78110b40fdd3c83afec5a065191a/research/local-eight-form-capture/historical/work/combined-pr/publication/research/e8-combined/vendor/complex/SOURCES.json) and original notices retain the earlier geometry and source pins.

Substantial OpenAI Codex and research-agent assistance was used for the local work, checks, review, and packaging. Independent agent review is not human review. Original notices and Apache-2.0 licensing remain. No full inherited or current supplier replay, proof-assistant check, complete invoice, outer recurrence, or hosted CI result is claimed. The broader centre-information breakthrough remains unresolved; these two local capabilities are the contribution.
